free_text: The patient is a 71-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 8.1 and a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone, correlating with a prior biopsy Gleason 3+3 (ISUP Grade Group 1). The competing illness is not specified. Management assessment is active surveillance, balancing the potential benefit of treatment against patient preferences. The trade-off involves monitoring for progression versus the risks and benefits of active treatment.
